traceability.notes: All parts of Story 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are fully implemented: - Parser logic now recognizes any non-traceability JSDoc tag as a boundary, terminates @story/@req values correctly, and only treats non-tag lines as continuations. - Traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags. - Multi-line values are preserved and terminated properly at tag boundaries. - A regression test for the original bug scenario (req followed by param) is present and passing, confirming no invalid concatenation. - Documentation for the valid-annotation-format rule explicitly documents JSDoc coexistence with examples. - The full Jest suite, including all new tests for this story, passes, and prior behavior remains intact. Thus this story is fully satisfied and the assessment status is PASSED.
